held.reason: Khowar naskār nose has a direct Bashir 2023 p.102 (printed 89) dictionary match naskár, but its etymology only says from Sanskrit (M:1973), without a named form. Nuristani PNur nāskār face and Waigali naskār nose and ears/beauty are comparisons, not demonstrated immediate donors; the Waigali karṇa edge is explicitly only a CDIAL grouping. Full nāsā 7089 and karṇa 2830 do not establish this whole Khowar compound. Preserve a possible nose-plus-ear or contact explanation for primary research, without asserting a Nuristani loan or treating this as simple uncertainty solely between IA lects.
